provenance.source: Numerical Dinkinesh shape distributed with the TEMPEST thermal model: 635 vertices and 1,266 triangles, retained at their published metre scale. The linked study describes a Lucy stereo-derived model with estimated unseen terrain. This recovered file does not identify its upstream mission-model version or observed/fill boundary. The grid marks missing qualified photography; it does not mark measured terrain. JPL supplies the heliocentric orbit; the mesh view has no propagated spin epoch.
provenance.qualification: Computed Dinkinesh Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
